title: Dining Plan Agreement: Plan Changes, Cancellation and End of Residency
content:
## Terms of the Dining Plan on changing, cancelling and ending a plan

**Clause 1 - When a change takes effect.** A plan change takes effect on the first day of the next month when it is requested on or before the 20th of the month, and on the first day of the month after next when it is requested later.

**Clause 2 - How many changes.** The plan changes on the plan within the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the requested change date, the requested change included, may not exceed 4.

**Clause 3 - Floor of a change.** A change may not go below the minimum plan an independent living resident must hold.

**Clause 4 - When a cancellation ends the plan.** A cancellation signed on or before the 20th of the month ends the plan on the last day of that month, and a cancellation signed later ends it on the last day of the following month. Once the cancellation is signed, the plan is in cancel pending status, with its end date recorded, until it ends on that date.

**Clause 5 - Minimum commitment.** A plan may not be cancelled or lowered before its minimum commitment has run from its effective date: 0 months on the Dining 10 Meal Plan and 1 month on the Dining 15, 30, 45 and 60 Meal Plans and the Dining Full Board Plan.

**Clause 6 - Withdrawing a cancellation.** A cancellation may be withdrawn before its end date; the plan is then active again and the cancellation date and end date are cleared.

**Clause 7 - Residents bound by the minimum.** A resident who must hold the minimum plan may not cancel while their independent living residency continues; the cancellation must instead be a change to an allowed plan.

**Clause 8 - End of the residency.** When the independent living residency ends, the plan ends on the residency's fee end date. Because every plan of the Dining Plan provides proration when the residency ends, the plan fee for the later days of the month - the days after the fee end date - is credited as a residency-end proration credit. The daily fee is the monthly plan fee divided by the number of days in the month, rounded to the cent half up; the credit is that rounded daily fee multiplied by the number of later days.

**Clause 9 - Fee increases.** A plan fee increase takes effect only after 30 calendar days of written notice.

**Clause 10 - Status.** Plan changes and cancellations may be requested only while the plan is in active status; a plan in pending start, cancel pending or ended status does not take a change or a cancellation request.

## Cutoff days on both sides (hypothetical dates)

| Request | Signed or requested on | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Plan change | 20th of the month | Takes effect on the 1st of the next month |
| Plan change | 21st of the month | Takes effect on the 1st of the month after next |
| Cancellation | 20th of the month | Plan ends on the last day of that month |
| Cancellation | 21st of the month | Plan ends on the last day of the following month |

## Counting changes (hypothetical histories)

- Three changes already fall within the 12 calendar months ending on the requested change date. With the requested change the count is 4, which does not exceed 4: the change may be made.
- Four changes already fall within that window. With the requested change the count is 5, which exceeds 4: the change may not be made.

## Residency-end proration worked through (hypothetical)

A resident on the Dining 15 Meal Plan, monthly plan fee 249.00 US dollars, leaves independent living with a fee end date of the 21st of a 31-day month. The daily fee is 249.00 divided by 31, which is 8.0322..., rounded half up to 8.03. The later days are the 22nd to the 31st, 10 days. The residency-end proration credit is 10 multiplied by 8.03, which is 80.30 US dollars, and the plan ends on the 21st.
